modules.zz:policies/orrery/mars-light-time:
# Astronomy demonstration arithmetic; this is not a law encoding.
# Fixed-position geometric range divided by the exact SI speed of light.
# The native engine supplies every computed value; no Receipt verdict is implied.
format: rulespec/v1
units:
  - name: km/s
    kind: custom
    label: kilometers per second
  - name: s
    kind: custom
    label: seconds
  - name: min
    kind: custom
    label: minutes
rules:
  - name: speed_of_light_km_per_second
    kind: parameter
    dtype: Decimal
    unit: km/s
    versions:
      - effective_from: 1900-01-01
        formula: "299792.458"
  - name: fixed_position_one_way_seconds
    kind: derived
    entity: Observation
    dtype: Decimal
    unit: s
    period: Day
    versions:
      - effective_from: 1900-01-01
        formula: range_km / speed_of_light_km_per_second
  - name: fixed_position_one_way_minutes
    kind: derived
    entity: Observation
    dtype: Decimal
    unit: min
    period: Day
    versions:
      - effective_from: 1900-01-01
        formula: fixed_position_one_way_seconds / 60
